_comment: Single source for the USD->INR rate. CSV INR columns are derived from USD columns x this rate (2dp, no grouping). UI labels, index.html meta, and README STATS all render from this file (via src/lib/fx.generated.ts) — never hardcode the rate elsewhere. Change the rate here, then run: npm run data -- --recompute-inr
source: Repo-standardized planning rate (standardized Aug 14, 2026; not a live quote). Refresh from the RBI/FBIL USD-INR reference rate for the current date, update as_of, then recompute.
